documents.title: Information memorandum
documents.text:
Information memorandum — Pellwood Industries (fictional).
In this document "PIH" means Pellwood Industries. Pellwood Industries reports gross margin of 44.9% for FY2024. Pellwood Industries reports headcount of 2027 for FY2025. Pellwood Industries reports earn out of $36.1m for LTM to 30 Jun 2025 on a reported basis. Pellwood AB reports normalised net working capital of $83.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis. The fiscal year of Pellwood Industries ends on 30 June.

Financial due diligence report — Pellwood Industries (fictional).
Pellwood Industries reports gross profit margin of 40.4% for FY2024. Pellwood Industries reports headcount of 1792 for FY2025. Pellwood Industries reports enterprise value of $818.2m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Pellwood Industries reports annual customer churn of 5% for FY2024.

Draft share purchase agreement — Pellwood Industries (fictional).

Pellwood Industries reports annual customer churn of 4.2% for FY2024. "gross profit margin" has the same meaning as "gross margin".
